actual_request.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one production 8-direction walking sprite for 10_crimson_spear_girl, frame S05 of a 16-frame 30ms walk loop. Generate ONE complete original 1024x1024 or larger square single frame, on genuinely transparent alpha, no sheet, labels, checkerboard, floor, shadow, background or effects. Image 1 is the authoritative identity reference. Preserve her exact brown double buns with long twin tails, red ribbons, ornate gold and pale turquoise hair ornaments, amber eyes, red jeweled forehead ornament, red/white/gold layered costume, gold trim and waist beads, red/gold boots, and the same long dark-shaft crimson gold spear with red tassels. Image 2 is the confirmed main STYLE reference: match clean bright rounded Daoist chibi hand-painted material, delicate warm shading and finished edges; do not copy its interface, characters or change this girl's colors. Identity takes priority. Turn her into a grounded walking pose facing exactly SOUTH toward camera, fixed slightly elevated game camera, no yaw or tilt, whole head, twin tails, sleeves, spear and both boots fully inside canvas. Match original chibi proportion and costume faithfully. Body center x=512, ground contact y=942 on a 1024 canvas; standing body about 700 pixels from head/buns to foot, max full equipment extent inside x=65..960 and y=45..952. Stable two-hand grip: her left hand high by chest, her right hand low by waist, spear diagonal with tip to screen upper-right, butt lower-left, both hands physically gripping one straight shaft. WALK PHASE 05, passing pose: anatomical LEFT leg (screen RIGHT) stands nearly straight under its hip with its entire boot sole firmly on the ground, supporting her weight. Anatomical RIGHT leg (screen LEFT) swings forward through center with knee mildly flexed and boot raised only a small amount off the ground beside the support ankle. Two separate foot lanes, support left boot lower than swinging right boot, no overlap or crossing. This is an upright passing WALK pose, not a standing pose. Neither a leap, run, kick, attack, crossed legs nor standing. Make clean leg articulation and genuine weight-bearing contact with a small natural counter-swing of hair and sleeves. Do not reproduce the lifted-knee airborne portrait pose. Highest available visual finish. No purple/magenta rim, no colored matte. Image 3 is the current front walking reference: preserve precisely this rendering, character dimensions, outfit and spear grip while drawing the specified DIFFERENT leg pose from scratch. Keep same head top, eye line, head width, torso length and position, cloak and full spear size as image 3. Knee flexion subtle and foot low. No large knee lift. Return exactly one new full sprite.
